children: Engineered pipe services provider's Q2 fiscal net sales rose 24% yr/yr, driven by higher volumes
Q2 net income attributable to common stock increased, aided by discrete tax benefit and receivable provision
Company backlog reached $142.3 mln, supported by over $67 mln in new Q2 awards
Company says strong backlog and growing RFP pipeline support outlook for continued growth
Perma-Pipe expects expanded Ohio and Qatar facilities to meet higher demand in key markets
Company sees new joint venture in Jordan supporting large-scale infrastructure projects
SALES VOLUMES - Higher sales volumes in North America and MENA drove net sales growth
COST PRESSURES - Increased materials and logistics costs, plus ramp-up costs at the new Ohio facility, reduced gross margin
RECEIVABLE CHARGE AND TAX BENEFIT - Results included a $3.9 mln charge for an uncollectible receivable and a $1.6 mln discrete tax benefit
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the iron & steel peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Perma-Pipe International Holdings Inc is $32.00, about 9.9% above its September 8 closing price of $29.11
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
